title: .task(id:): Automatic Restart & Cancellation

docs.title: Managing model data in your app

hints: Keep a reference to the current `Task` so you can cancel it.
Restart only when the id actually changes; `disappear` cancels.
The task checks `Task.isCancelled` after its sleep.
jsBridge: `.task(id:)` starts async work when the view appears, cancels on disappear, and restarts when `id` changes. That's React's `useEffect` with a dependency array and an `AbortController` cleanup, built in.
